subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the stylized 3D anime girl in <Picture 1>, preserving her facial identity, dark green chin-length bob with bangs and side hairpin, green eyes, white high-neck ribbed knit sweater dress, gray techwear long coat with yellow shoulder panel, hanging straps and metal buckles, black tights, and black chunky boots, rendered in the same stylized 3D anime game CG style as the reference.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 10-second, 9:16 vertical stylized 3D anime game CG performance short in which <Subject 1> performs a boxing-based martial arts routine on a cyberpunk stage, using extremely complex spatial camera movement including a rising orbit, whip pan, low rotating follow, crash push-in facial close-up, and pull-back overhead rotation, with a dedicated facial close-up shot and a continuous cyberpunk electronic score.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the girl's facial identity, dark green bob with hairpin, green eyes, white knit dress, gray techwear coat with yellow shoulder accent, straps, buckles, black tights, and boots are retained while she performs new martial arts actions in a new cyberpunk stage environment.

detailed_description:
The target video is a 10-second, 9:16 vertical stylized 3D anime game CG performance short with a global cyberpunk aesthetic: neon light columns, holographic projections, sweeping stage light beams, and low ground smoke; a cool cyan-magenta neon grade with yellow accent highlights, and consistent stylized rendering, lens grammar, and motion vocabulary across all shots. No dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, and no extra characters.
[Shot 1] The shot opens on a low angle behind the cyberpunk stage, with <Subject 1> centered amid neon columns, holograms, and ground smoke, her dark green bob, hairpin, white knit dress, gray coat with yellow shoulder panel, straps, black tights, and boots clearly visible. From 00:00-00:01, the camera rises fast from a low rear position and begins an arc around her as she drops her weight and raises her fists into a guard with clear anticipation. From 00:01-00:02, the camera continues its ascending arc toward the front while she snaps a sharp jab, coat hem and straps swinging with follow-through. From 00:02-00:03, the camera completes the near-180-degree orbit to a frontal low angle as she lands a straight cross, neon flares and light beams sweeping behind her; crisp punch whooshes accompany each strike.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, a whip pan cuts to a side low-angle tracking shot. From 00:03-00:04, the camera hugs her side as she slips sideways to dodge, background neon stretching into light trails. From 00:04-00:05, the camera dives lower and begins rotating upward while she drives an uppercut with a strong action line. From 00:05-00:05.5, the rotating rise continues as she completes a spinning kick with a readable silhouette; footstep friction and impact thuds land on the beat.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the impact cuts to a crash push-in facial close-up of <Subject 1>, her face centered with safe space around it. Her green eyes are sharp and focused, breath slightly quickened, bangs and coat collar still settling from the previous motion, neon light spots reflected in her pupils. From 00:06-00:08, the camera continues a very slow straight push toward an even tighter eye-level close-up as her expression eases from tension into a faint confident smile; the score brakes and ducks under this braking moment.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a rapid pull-back that rises into an overhead rotating view. <Subject 1> steps in and throws a final heavy straight punch, then instantly freezes in a composed finishing pose with a clear silhouette; smoke and light beams converge behind her, and the camera stabilizes into a steady high-angle hold on the pose until 00:10.000, ending on a strong final beat hit.

overall_soundscape:
Punch whooshes, padded impact thuds, footstep friction on the stage floor, cloth and strap swish, and a low stage ambience of smoke hiss and distant electrical hum support the performance.

non_diegetic_music:
A continuous cyberpunk electronic score with driving synth bass, pulsing arpeggios, and percussive beats builds energy through the action shots, ducks and brakes under the facial close-up, and resolves with a final heavy hit on the last punch and pose hold.
